name: shambling mound
desc: Shambling Mound is a CR 5 plant.

actions.name: lightning absorption
actions.desc: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .mmChargedTendril]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .mmEngulf00000000]].

actions.name: charged tendril
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: engulf
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5o0Bh8PQaojx5XMx]], one [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=5o0Bh8PQaojx5XMx]] within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space and has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Until the grapple ends, the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, and it takes [[/damage average activity=Exfa4q7O4SvXjGt7]] damage at the start of each of its turns. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.
